annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear and unambiguous directive: if an endpoint is sending packets with a zero-length Destination Connection ID and receives a NEW_CONNECTION_ID frame, it must treat this as a connection error of type PROTOCOL_VIOLATION. There is no ambiguity in the required behavior, as the condition and consequence are explicitly defined.
